# Agent Python Tools

- repo: open-webui/openapi-servers
- repo_uri: https://github.com/open-webui/openapi-servers

## File: open-webui_openapi-servers/servers/weather/main.py

Prompts

```
['run the fastapi weather api server that serves the forecast endpoint with cors middleware', 'get the current weather and hourly forecast for a latitude and longitude using open-meteo', 'review the weatherforecastoutput pydantic model that validates latitude, longitude, current weather, and hourly data', 'review the currentweather pydantic model with time, temperature, and wind speed fields', 'refactor the fahrenheit countries set to add or remove countries that use fahrenheit temperature units']
```

Usage

```
{'run_weather_api_server': 'run the fastapi weather api server that serves the forecast endpoint with cors middleware', 'get_weather_forecast_by_coords': 'get the current weather and hourly forecast for a latitude and longitude using open-meteo', 'review_weatherforecastoutput_model': 'review the weatherforecastoutput pydantic model that validates latitude, longitude, current weather, and hourly data', 'review_currentweather_model': 'review the currentweather pydantic model with time, temperature, and wind speed fields', 'refactor_fahrenheit_countries': 'refactor the fahrenheit countries set to add or remove countries that use fahrenheit temperature units'}
```
